title: Dutch found Batavia
summary: In 1619 Jan Pieterszoon Coen's forces razed Jayakarta, expelled its people and founded Batavia on its ruins. It became the centre of the Dutch East India Company's trading network in Asia.
why: The seed of Dutch colonial rule in Indonesia; the city is today's Jakarta.

notes.problem: Sober wording: source says Coen razed Jayakarta and expelled its population; summary hid the violence.
